title: Objects of Thought
note: Dimension table for the 'Objects of Thought No.' column of Table V (referenced there as object_ids). Per chapter-5-source.md, either one of 6 objects of the senses (1-6, or a range/'all' covering them, e.g. "1-6"), or one of 22 specifically dhyanic objects, which the source brackets as [1]-[22] to distinguish them from the sense-object numbering. 'sense_objects' and 'dhyanic_objects' are therefore kept as two separate lists sharing this one dimension table.

water-device

note_kasina: ids 1-8 are the classic set of 8 kasiṇa (meditation-device) objects: earth, water, fire, air, and the four colours black-blue/yellow/red/white. ids 9-18 are the asubha (foulness/corpse) contemplations, the traditional set of 10 (though the source only brackets ids 10-12 as '[10]'-'[12]'; ids 13-18 appear unbracketed -- likely just a typesetting inconsistency in the original, not a meaningful distinction). ids 19-22 are the four arūpa (formless) attainments in order: unbounded space, unbounded consciousness, nothingness, neither-notion-nor-nonnotion. This completes the 22-item dhyanic object list chapter-5-source.md describes.
